items.title: Rivian raises 2026 delivery forecast on strong demand, R2 boost
items.summary: Rivian has boosted its 2026 delivery outlook, anticipating strong sales for its electric vans and R1 lineup, bolstered by the new, more affordable R2 model. Second-quarter deliveries exceeded expectations, driven by demand across its range. Uber's significant investment further signals confidence in Rivian's future.

items.summary: The initiative is expected to reduce more than 8,900 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and displace around 2.9 million litres of diesel consumption each year.

items.title: BMW completes $1.7 billion investment in EV production at US plants
items.summary: BMW has poured $1.7 billion into its South Carolina facilities, preparing for a significant shift to electric vehicle production in the US. The German automaker's Spartanburg plant and a new Woodruff facility are now set to build the all-electric iX5 SUV from late 2026, with at least five more EV models planned by 2030.

items.title: BYD India introduces prices hike in select electric car variants by up to ₹1 lakh
items.summary: Revised prices take effect from July 1; company also introduces new eMAX 7 Comfort variant starting at ₹27.90 lakh.

items.title: China's BYD nears decision on second European plant, says adviser
items.summary: China's electric vehicle giant BYD is nearing a decision to acquire an existing European auto plant, potentially in Spain or France, to accelerate its regional expansion. This move comes as BYD's sales in Europe surge dramatically.

items.title: Lamborghini unveils 812 hp Urus SE Performante with hybrid powertrain
items.summary: The plug-in hybrid performance SUV delivers 812 hp, 1,000 Nm of torque, a 3.3-second 0-100 km/h sprint, and over 60 km of electric range.

items.title: Samvardhana Motherson Realigns Target Deadlines for Three Global Acquisitions
items.summary: Global automotive components manufacturer Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has adjusted the expected completion timelines for three separate international acquisitions, according to regulatory disclosures filed on Tuesday. The updates modify the closing schedules for corporate transactions across its operations in Japan, Europe, and South Africa.

items.title: Lumax Auto Technologies Consolidates Ownership in Joint Venture Subsidiary Lumax FAE Technologies
items.summary: Automotive component manufacturer Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has completed the acquisition of the remaining 15.97 percent equity stake in its joint venture subsidiary, Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited. The transactions were concluded on Monday following an initial regulatory intimation filed by the company on May 29, 2026.

items.title: Heavy Industries Ministry Extends Global Tender Deadline for Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has extended the bid submission timeline for its global tender under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet. Following requests from multiple industry stakeholders, the bid due date has been moved from June 29 to July 29, 2026.

items.title: PLI, duty incentives soon for lithium, nickel processing units in India
items.summary: This strategic move aims to reduce reliance on overseas processors and bolster the nation's critical minerals ecosystem. The initiative supports the National Critical Minerals Mission and aligns with projected growth in demand for electric vehicle batteries.

items.title: Battery PLI scheme stumbles as no penalties realised, beneficiaries now want extension
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has been issuing quarterly penalty notices to defaulting companies which have missed capacity installation deadlines, but not a single rupee has been realised so far.
